jobs.title: Senior Product Owner
Founding PM/GTM | EverWorker
jobs.description:
Role: Founding Product / GTM Lead

Company: EverWorker

Location: US or Europe (remote, US timezone overlap required)

Job Type: Full-time

About EverWorker

EverWorker is building the AI-native layer that makes legacy CRM obsolete. The thesis: sales teams shouldn't have to live inside rigid, hand-coded databases – intelligent agents should handle the process instead.

The product is in its fourth iteration, built to sit alongside HubSpot and Salesforce – not replace them overnight, but do one thing better, then another, until the old stack becomes unnecessary. The company is backed by an experienced SaaS investor with a $5M commitment and a direct pipeline to US SMB customers through an Ohio-based accelerator.

The team is 8-10 people, fully distributed across Atlanta, Kyiv, London, Zurich, and Spain. The product is ready. What's needed now is someone to find the right message.

What you are expected to do

  • Own the GTM motion from day one: run focused experiments, one message at a time, 2-3 weeks per iteration, measure, iterate

  • Write landing pages, outbound sequences, and sales messaging yourself – there is no product marketing team

  • Close the first 5 paying customers ($1k/month each) alongside the CEO within 3 months

  • Define and refine the ICP through real conversations with US SMBs

  • Translate market signals into product direction – be the customer's voice inside the team

  • Build the playbook that a sales team will eventually scale

What you need to succeed

  • You've lived inside a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Gong, or similar) – as a user or builder – and you understand what's broken at a product level, not just a workflow level

  • You've done GTM work at an early-stage B2B startup: landing pages, outbound, first sales calls, not just PRDs and roadmaps

  • You're comfortable in pre-PMF ambiguity – figuring out the message is the job, not inheriting one

  • You write clear, direct English copy without a copywriter

  • Track record: at least one story where you moved a metric from zero, even if the company didn't make it

  • US or Europe timezone with meaningful overlap with US East Coast

What you get

  • Warm pipeline from day one: the investor's Ohio Accelerator gives you access to US SMBs without cold outreach from scratch

  • A team that ships: the product is ready and the engineering team is fast – your job is to find the message, not wait for features

  • Full ownership: you set the GTM direction, the messaging, and eventually who you hire

jobs.title: Sr. Account Executive, Retail Media
jobs.description:
Help retailers turn shopper intent into a growing media business

Constructor helps e-commerce businesses connect shoppers with the products they want through AI-powered search and product discovery.

We’re looking for an experienced Retail Media sales professional to help grow our business across EMEA. You’ll work with retailers to understand their monetisation ambitions, build compelling business cases and sell technology that helps them develop and scale their Retail Media offering.

This is a hands-on commercial role—not a campaign-operations position. You’ll combine deep industry knowledge with enterprise sales discipline, working alongside Account Managers and the wider Sales team to turn qualified opportunities into lasting customer partnerships.

What you’ll do

Own Retail Media opportunities from discovery to close

  • Identify and qualify opportunities with retailers looking to launch, improve or scale their Retail Media business.

  • Lead consultative discovery with Retail Media, e-commerce, commercial and technology stakeholders.

  • Build opportunity strategies with clear decision processes, executive engagement and agreed next steps.

  • Lead proposals, negotiations and commercial agreements in partnership with the relevant account owner.

  • Maintain a credible pipeline and an evidence-based forecast.

Build business cases that stand up to scrutiny

  • Understand each retailer’s commercial model, advertiser demand, inventory and operational readiness.

  • Translate those inputs into clear monetisation scenarios, with transparent assumptions and measurable success criteria.

  • Explain how sponsored products, display formats and relevant integration approaches can support the retailer’s objectives.

  • Work with technical and product specialists to define demonstrations, proof plans and realistic delivery expectations.

  • Help customers evaluate revenue potential alongside shopper relevance, customer experience and operational requirements.

Navigate a complex buying group

  • Build relationships with senior Retail Media, digital, commercial and technology leaders.

  • Help stakeholders align around the opportunity, investment and path to launch.

  • Understand the relationship between retailer economics and the needs of brands, sellers and agencies.

  • Address commercial and organisational blockers rather than treating every challenge as a product gap.

Make the wider commercial team stronger

  • Partner with Account Managers on Retail Media expansion opportunities within existing customer relationships.

  • Support Sales colleagues where Retail Media is part of a broader customer proposition.

  • Share discovery frameworks, objection handling, business-case approaches and lessons from live deals.

  • Help develop a repeatable Retail Media sales motion across EMEA.

  • Ensure closed opportunities move into delivery with clear commitments, ownership and success criteria.

Bring market insight into the business

  • Share customer feedback, competitive insights and emerging buying requirements with Product and leadership.

  • Represent Constructor in relevant customer conversations and industry events.

  • Help sharpen our positioning through practical knowledge of what retailers need to build a sustainable media business.

What you’ll bring

  • A proven track record selling Retail Media, commerce media or closely related advertising technology.

  • Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles, from discovery and business case through negotiation and close.

  • A strong understanding of retailer monetisation and the relationships between retailers, brands, sellers and agencies.

  • The ability to discuss media performance, measurement and incrementality—and distinguish credible evidence from assumptions.

  • Confidence engaging senior commercial and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong commercial judgment, pipeline discipline and forecasting skills.

  • An ability to make complex technology and business models easy to understand.

  • A collaborative approach: you can lead a specialist sales motion while respecting the broader customer relationship.

  • Professional fluency in English.

Your experience may come from a Retail Media platform, an adtech provider or a retailer’s media business. What matters is your ability to combine industry expertise with demonstrated commercial delivery.

It would be a bonus if you have

  • Experience selling retailer-facing technology that enables Retail Media networks.

  • Experience with sponsored products, onsite display, auctions or mediation.

  • Familiarity with enterprise e-commerce and product discovery.

  • Experience working across several EMEA markets.

  • Relationships within the European Retail Media ecosystem.

  • Additional European language skills.

What success looks like

You build a qualified pipeline, develop strong customer business cases and convert opportunities into commercial partnerships. Customers understand both the growth opportunity and what it will take to realise it.

You also create impact beyond your own deals: Account Managers and Sales colleagues become more confident in Retail Media conversations, customer commitments are clear, and market feedback helps shape a more effective proposition.

  • Help shape a specialist Retail Media sales motion across EMEA.

  • Work at the intersection of AI-powered commerce, shopper experience and retailer monetisation.

  • Combine ownership of complex deals with influence on positioning and commercial strategy.

  • Work closely with commercial, product and technical teams to turn customer ambitions into actionable plans.

Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 18-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Team Lead to take ownership of our Reporting platform and lead the team responsible for its evolution. This is a player-coach role for a staff-level data engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong engineering leadership and people management skills.

You will help design, deploy, and evolve the data infrastructure that powers Adikteev’s reporting and analytics systems. You will be both the technical architect of the platform and the manager of the team that enables reliable, scalable, and high-value reporting for our internal and external users.

As the team lead, you won't just "execute" tasks. You will shape our technical DNA and support the growth of the team.

Engineering:

  • Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for our Reporting platform and data infrastructure.

  • Architect, scale, and maintain our data infrastructure, ensuring it meets the rigorous demands of reporting, analytics, and business intelligence workflows.

  • Make sure data is always available and reliable: oversee processing, storage, aggregation, transformation, and API development.

  • Streamline our data processes by integrating efficient testing, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and error recovery.

  • Design and implement robust data models and transformation pipelines that make reporting data easy to discover, understand, and use.

  • Build and optimize highly scalable pipelines using Apache Airflow and Apache Spark, focusing on high reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

  • Establish best practices for data quality, CI/CD for data, observability, technical documentation, and operational excellence.

  • Contribute to innovation efforts by exploring promising ideas from recent academic and industry work and turning them into production-grade solutions.

  • Leverage AI coding tools such as Copilot and Claude to accelerate development cycles and stay at the forefront of engineering productivity.

  • Remain hands-on where it creates the most leverage, contributing to system design, code reviews, critical implementation work, and incident resolution.

Management:

  • Lead, support, and develop the Reporting engineering team, creating the conditions for engineers to do their best work.

  • Set clear objectives, priorities, and expectations for the team, aligned with company and product goals.

  • Manage the team’s roadmap and delivery, balancing business priorities, platform reliability, technical debt, and long-term investments.

  • Provide regular feedback, coaching, and career development support to team members.

  • Mentor Data and Backend Engineers and help them grow their technical scope, ownership, and leadership skills.

  • Participate in recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews, and team planning.

  • Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high engineering standards.

  • Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and technical risks before they impact the business, and communicate architectural decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

WHO YOU ARE

You might be a great fit for our Reporting team if you have experience in several of the following areas:

  • Experience: Proven track record as a Staff Data Engineer, Lead Data Engineer, Principal Data Engineer, or Engineering Manager with a strong data engineering background. You have worked on production systems where latency, throughput, availability, reliability, and infrastructure cost matter.

  • Data Volume: Experience working with very large-scale data systems. At Adikteev, our platforms process more than 5 billion events per day and reach over 5 million QPS on some services. You are comfortable designing systems that can handle high data volumes, demanding throughput, and strict reliability requirements.

  • Technical Stack: Hands-on expertise with Apache Spark, including tuning and scaling, as well as Apache Airflow and complex DAG orchestration. Kafka streaming, Kubernetes, and AWS are a plus.

  • Coding Skills: You are an "AI-native" developer who embraces AI tools to write better and faster code. Hands-on experience with Scala. Python and Java are a plus.

  • Data Modeling: Strong experience designing data models for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases. Experience with dimensional modeling, data warehouses, or data lakes is a plus.

  • Data Transformation: Solid understanding of how to transform raw data into accurate, consistent, and easy-to-use reporting datasets. Experience building or maintaining reporting or analytics platforms is a strong plus.

  • Engineering Leadership: Experience defining technical direction, setting engineering standards, driving execution across teams, and making architectural decisions at staff level.

  • People Management: Experience managing, mentoring, and developing engineers, providing regular feedback, supporting career growth, and building a high-performing team.

  • Communication: Fluent in English and able to articulate complex architectural choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable creating alignment across teams and communicating clearly at every level.

Please note that, to comply with employment regulations, applicants are required to maintain residency and be legally authorized to work in the European Union in order to be considered for this position.

COMPENSATION

  • Competitive Salary between 100,000 and 120,000€ OTE

We are committed to transparent compensation practices. The salary range shown reflects total On-Target Earnings (OTE), including base salary and a performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs. Final compensation will be tailored to each candidate’s background, experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • 4 1/2 days work week (Fridays afternoon off);

  • Longevity bonus every 2 years;

  • Profit-sharing scheme

  • Healthcare plan with excellent coverage;

  • Lunch Vouchers;

  • Mental Health support;

  • Flexible remote working policy;

  • Regular team-life event / activity;

  • Inclusive parental leave Policy.

*Most benefits are available to all employees. For remote team members based outside of France, benefits will be aligned with local laws and practices in your country of residence, ensuring support that’s both relevant and compliant wherever you are. 

OUR PROCESS

What to expect as you move through our hiring process:

  • HR call with Maxime, Team Lead - Talent Acquisition,

  • Technical interview with Youcef, Senior Engineering Team Lead, & Adrian, Senior Data Engineer

  • Team fit interview with Aldenis, VP Engineering, 

  • A final interview with Cédric, Chief Technology Officer and Loïc, Chief Product Officer. 

If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know. It will be handled confidentially by our HR and recruitment team.

OUR COMMITMENT

We’re proud that our team already spans 22+ nationalities, diverse talent and unique backgrounds, and we want it to grow even more. If this role appeals to you, we welcome your application, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. Not everyone gets through our hiring process, but your skills might be a great fit for another opportunity; now or in the future.

Nucs AI is looking for a Senior Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of complex technology and specialized end-users. You will own critical parts of our product roadmap, translating deep clinical and technical requirements into clear product direction, then driving execution across data, engineering, regulatory, and commercial areas.   • Translate ambiguous, technically complex problems into well-structured product requirements and clear success criteria.

  • Develop and articulate a clear product narrative: why this feature matters, who it serves, and how it connects to the broader platform vision.

  • Navigate the regulatory landscape (FDA, CE marking) as a stakeholder, you do not need to be a regulatory expert, but you must understand how regulatory requirements shape product decisions and timelines.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Drive cross-functional execution with engineering, AI/ML, clinical, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders, keeping a small team moving fast without sacrificing quality.
